plan.notes: Source: Monroe Community College official Nursing A.A.S. program sheet (monroecc.edu) - the traditional four-semester pathway. The program sheet states no catalog year; the identical sequence appears on the current program page (verified 2026-10-09) - filed as 2026-2027, disclosed here. Transcribed exactly as published: 18+18+16+12 = 64 ("TOTAL CREDITS: 64"). Every course requires a grade of C or higher (per the sheet). The sheet's "#" (MTH 160) and "*" (BIO 144/145/202) footnote keys were not captured in the source text - documented in the slot notes rather than guessed. Competitive admission - see the Health Related Programs site for current admission criteria. Program is ACEN-accredited. Prerequisites recorded for the sequential clinical chain (NUR 112 after NUR 110+111; NUR 211/212 after NUR 112; NUR 214 after NUR 211+212) and BIO 145 after BIO 144.
